properties.displayName: [WEEKLY] Package-Manager Install Hook Spawns Interpreter then Beacons Out (Supply-Chain Worm Install-Time Execution)
properties.description:
Detects the install-time execution primitive shared by every supply-chain worm wave observed this fortnight: a package-manager process (npm / npx / yarn / pnpm / bun / composer / php) runs a tampered dependency whose lifecycle hook (preinstall, postinstall, Composer autoloader, or `vendor/autoload.php`) spawns a scripting interpreter (powershell, pwsh, cmd, sh / bash, node, bun, python, php, curl, wget) which then makes outbound public-internet egress within a short window. This catches all five waves reported between 11-23 May 2026: 'TanStack Npm Packages Compromised Inside The Mini Shai Hulud Supply Chain Attack' (Snyk), 'Mini Shai-Hulud Is Back: npm Worm Hits over 160 Packages, including Mistral and Tanstack' (Aikido), 'TeamPCP's Mini Shai-Hulud Is Back: A Self-Spreading Supply Chain Attack' (StepSecurity), 'Mini Shai-Hulud Hits AntV: 300+ Malicious npm Packages' (Snyk) + 'Mini Shai Hulud: Compromised @antv npm packages enable CI/CD credential theft' (Microsoft / StepSecurity), and the Laravel-Lang Composer tag-rewrite hijack (Cyber Security News, BleepingComputer, The Hacker News, StepSecurity, Aikido). Kill-chain stages: install (lifecycle-hook execution under a trusted pkg-manager parent) -> c2/actions (interpreter beacons to attacker infra or exfiltrates CI secrets). Fires when an install command on a developer workstation or CI runner is followed within ~10 min by an interpreter on the same host reaching a public destination; does NOT fire on routine pkg-manager use whose only egress is to known registries (registry.npmjs.org, packagist.org, github.com, codeload, ghcr, *.actions.githubusercontent.com) — those should be excluded via an allow-list rather than the detection schema, so new attacker domains (git-tanstack.com, *.getsession.org, t.m-kosche.com, git-service.com, flipboxstudio.info today; whatever next week) light up automatically.

Rationale: Every article in scope — npm Mini Shai-Hulud waves against TanStack, Mistral and @antv plus the Laravel-Lang Composer tag-rewrite — relies on the same install-time primitive: a tampered package's lifecycle hook executes under a trusted pkg-manager parent, spawns an interpreter, and beacons out within minutes. IOCs (git-tanstack.com, *.getsession.org, t.m-kosche.com, git-service.com, flipboxstudio.info, the SHA256 set) all rotate per wave, but the parent->interpreter->egress correlation is invariant across npm + Composer ecosystems and across Windows + Linux developer/CI hosts, which is why the existing IOC-bound hunts in the catalogue (UC_3_5 / UC_9_8 / UC_12_8 / UC_15_7 / UC_69_8 / UC_113_8 / UC_184_9 / UC_195_10) all miss the next domain rotation while this one survives it.
properties.query:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let PkgManagers = dynamic(["npm.exe","npx.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","bun.exe","node.exe","composer","composer.phar","php.exe"]);
let InstallCmdTokens = dynamic(["npm install","npm ci","yarn install","yarn add","pnpm install","composer install","composer update","composer require","bun install","npx "]);
let Interpreters = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","sh","bash","zsh","node.exe","bun.exe","python.exe","python3","php.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe"]);
let KnownRegistries = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","npmjs.org","packagist.org","repo.packagist.org","github.com","codeload.github.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","actions.githubusercontent.com","ghcr.io","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org"]);
let InstallChain = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])),
             ChildName  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,  "\\")[-1]))
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | where ParentName in~ (PkgManagers)
         or ParentCommandLine has_any (InstallCmdTokens)
    | where ChildName in~ (Interpreters)
    | project InstallTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName,
              ParentName, ParentCmd = ParentCommandLine,
              ChildName, ChildCmd = CommandLine, ChildPid = NewProcessId;
let Egress = union isfuzzy=true
    (CommonSecurityLog
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
        | where isnotempty(DestinationHostName) or isnotempty(DestinationIP)
        | extend RemoteHost = tolower(coalesce(DestinationHostName, DestinationIP))
        | where not(RemoteHost has_any (KnownRegistries))
        | project NetTime = TimeGenerated, Computer = DeviceName, RemoteHost, DestinationPort),
    (DnsEvents
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
        | where SubType == "LookupQuery"
        | extend RemoteHost = tolower(Name)
        | where not(RemoteHost has_any (KnownRegistries))
        | project NetTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, RemoteHost, DestinationPort = int(null));
InstallChain
| join kind=inner Egress on Computer
| where NetTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, InstallTime)
| summarize InstallTime = min(InstallTime), NetTime = min(NetTime), DelaySec = min(DelaySec),
            ParentCmd = any(ParentCmd), ChildCmd = any(ChildCmd),
            Egresses = make_set(strcat(RemoteHost, ":", tostring(DestinationPort)), 25)
            by Computer, Account, ParentName, ChildName
| order by InstallTime desc
